title: Islamic New Year
note: The first day of Muharram begins the Hijri year.

title: Eid Milad-un-Nabi
note: Commemoration of the birth of the holy Prophet (peace be upon him); observed dates vary by community.

title: Isra and Mi'raj
note: Widely observed on 27 Rajab; observed dates vary.

title: First of Ramadan
note: The start of fasting depends on the sighting of the moon.

title: Laylat-ul-Qadr
note: Sought on the odd nights of the last ten days of Ramadan; the 27th night is widely observed.
